Medic pulled his glasses off to pinch at the bridge of his nose, and then replaced them. "Infirmary, Scout. Shoo."医生摘下眼镜，捏了捏鼻梁，然后又戴了回去。“去医务室，侦察兵。走开。”

Scout looked at Spy, limp and unconscious, and reconsidered. "Yeah, okay. Yeah, I got him." Medic swept away, white coat billowing, and Scout dipped to Spy's side. "Alright, man, let's go," he said to the unconscious man. One arm slipped behind his back and the other behind his knees, and Spy was in his arms, pressed against him, and damn, he was heavier than he looked. All muscle, he could feel it. Spy was waking up, and Scout's heart started beating again.侦察兵看了看瘫软昏迷的间谍，又改变了主意。“行，好吧。行，我来抱他。”医疗兵白大褂翻飞，快步离开了，侦察兵弯腰凑到间谍身边。“好了，哥们，我们走。”他对那个昏迷的人说。他一条手臂滑到间谍背后，另一条滑到膝弯下，间谍便落进了他怀里，紧贴着他——妈的，这家伙比看上去沉多了。浑身都是肌肉，他感觉得出来。他们朝基地走了大约十英尺，间谍的血一路滴落在白瓷砖上，接着他怀里的重量开始慢慢挪动。间谍正在醒来，侦察兵的心跳这才又重新响了起来。

"Hey, man." Scout leaned against the doorframe to the infirmary, trying to look as confident as he felt.“嘿，老兄。” Scout 靠在医务室的门框上，努力让自己看起来像感觉中那样自信。

More like five. "Never knew you were such a pussy, man."“那翻个身，让我看看。” Scout 用食指在空中画了个螺旋，Spy 顺从地翻身趴下。操，他的背真他妈结实。一条结实的背上，顺着往下大概缝了三十针。他在心里龇了下牙，但也只是在心里。“噗，真不敢相信你就那么晕过去了！看看这个，这大概有两英寸？”更像五英寸。“真没想到你这么怂，哥们。”

"'Course." Scout fished the cigarette case and lighter out of the breast pocket of the blue jacket draped over a chair (he knew they'd be there because he'd seen Spy pull them out a million times) and tossed them over. Spy caught the case deftly and lit one, balancing it elegantly between two fingers. "And be more fuckin' careful, by the way, you could have fuckin' died. "Point taken. You certainly couldn't do it by yourself," Spy smirked a little, and fuck knows why but Scout found it kind of sexy. "But, in all seriousness, there is something I must discuss with you. It is clear that you are attracted to me, and-" Scout cut him off by stuttering something, shit if he knew what, and his face heated up like crazy. "Hush, lapin." Spy said it simply, a command, but a careful one if tone means anything. Scout worked on trying to die in order to dodge Spy's next words. "You are attracted to me and I am attracted to you." Oh. Scout's eyes went wide and he sucked in a harsh, shocked breath, and bit the inside of his cheek and fiddled with the border of his athletic tape, and Spy ignored it and continued. "With things this way, perhaps we should arrange to meet somewhere privately to spend time alone together?"“说得有理。你一个人当然办不到。”间谍微微笑了笑，鬼知道为什么，侦察兵竟觉得这有点性感。“不过，说正经的，有件事我必须和你谈谈。很明显，你被我吸引了，而且——”侦察兵结结巴巴地打断了他，天知道他嘟囔了些什么，脸烫得要命。“嘘，小兔子。”间谍说得轻描淡写，是命令，但若语气能说明什么，那也是一道谨慎的命令。侦察兵恨不得当场死掉，好躲过间谍接下来的话。“你被我吸引了，而我也被你吸引了。”哦。侦察兵瞪大了眼睛，震惊地猛吸一口凉气，咬住脸颊内侧，手指摆弄着运动胶带的边缘，间谍没理会，继续说了下去。“既然这样，也许我们该安排个地方私下见面，单独待一会儿？”

After the doors of the infirmary slammed behind him, he ran to his room, almost tripping on the stairs, and spent the rest of the night trying to decide which of his shirts was the cleanest.医务室的门在他身后砰然关上，他跑回自己的房间，在楼梯上差点绊了一跤，余下的夜里都在纠结自己哪件衬衫最干净。

Scout was half an hour early, because damn it, a guy can only wait around in his room so much before a first date without wanting to pull his hair out, and that was really hard with hair as short as his. He had paced (which he was just realizing he did all the damn time), tried to read a sports mag and tried to talk to Demoman about whatever the hell, and none of that had worked so here he was.Scout 提前了半小时到，因为妈的，第一次约会前，一个人在房间里干等，等不了多久就会恨不得把头发揪光，可他那头发短成这样，想揪也没多少可揪的。他来来回回踱步（他刚意识到自己他妈的老是这样），试着读一本体育杂志，还试着跟 Demoman 扯些有的没的，结果全都没用，所以他就到这儿了。

He was flat on his back in the dust, looking up at the almost cloudless sky. It was starry out, always was out here, not like home. He could still taste that smoky, bitter, awesome Spy flavor on his tongue.“耶，哈哈，上二垒了，真他妈不赖！耶，宝贝儿！”侦察兵兴奋地大叫，跳起来朝空中挥了一拳。那他妈绝对是有史以来最棒的一次约会，基本上也是他妈这辈子发生在他身上最火辣的事。他那帮兄弟会花一大堆他妈的时间聊奶子什么的，去他妈的吧，那些废物没一个亲过 BLU 间谍。侦察兵用手背蹭了蹭嘴，因为他的嘴唇麻得要命。他舌头上还残留着那种烟熏火燎、发苦却又带劲的间谍味儿。

"Wohoohoo!" Scout shouted into the night again, breaking into a run, switching directions and going faster and faster, dashing forward into a crush that was turning into his first love, and what happened tomorrow didn't mean shit because tonight everything was awesome and kickass and really fucking perfect. He let himself collapse into the ground and rolled over to look at the stars again, and found the one they had been watching when Spy had grabbed his hand. Scout decided that one was theirs, and if he was a sappy kind of guy (and maybe he was, a little) he woulda made a wish and wished for this to be forever.“呜呼——！” Scout 又冲着夜色大喊了一声，撒腿跑了起来，左拐右拐，越跑越快，一头冲进那份正渐渐变成他初恋的心动里；明天会发生什么都他妈无所谓，因为今晚的一切都棒极了、酷毙了，真他妈完美。他任由自己瘫倒在地上，翻了个身又去看星星，找到了 Spy 抓住他的手时他们正一起望着的那颗星。Scout 认定那颗星是属于他们的；如果他是个多愁善感的家伙（也许他确实有一点），他就会许个愿，愿这一切永远持续下去。

==

It was poker night again, and they were gonna kick ass. It was only Medic, Heavy, and Engineer, but the pot was still pretty good: There was an extra blanket Medic threw in, and Scout was dying to get his hands on that. In case he wanted to have a sleepover or something. Heh.又到了扑克之夜，他们准备大杀四方。虽然只有医疗兵、重装兵和工程师在场，但赌池还是相当丰厚：医疗兵还额外押了一条毯子进去，侦察兵迫不及待地想把它弄到手。万一他想办个睡衣派对还是什么的呢。嘿。

"You bitches are smoked. I been practicin', queers." Scout swept up the cards up as they were tossed at him, shit-eating grin plastered all over his face.“你们这帮婊子都完蛋了。我可是练过的，基佬们。”侦察兵把扔向他的牌一把拢起，脸上挂着副欠揍的得意笑容。

Heavy laughed jovially. "Oh, leetle Scout is frightening, yes?" Scout just flipped him off and started arranging his cards in his hand. The game began.重装兵快活地大笑起来。“哦，小侦察兵很吓人，是吧？”侦察兵只是朝他竖了个中指，然后开始整理手里的牌。牌局开始了。

Under the table, they shuffled cards between them just the way they practiced, except now every time their fingers brushed Scout's chest would heat up and he'd have to try really hard not to smile. Once, after the card was passed, Spy ran his thumb over the back of Scout's hand. That made sitting still really hard, and he fell into his habit of bouncing his knees until Spy reached over and gripped his thigh to stop him. And damn right that stopped him real quick.桌子底下，他们照练习时的方式在两人之间洗着牌，只是现在每次手指擦过，Scout 的胸口都会发烫，他得拼命忍住才不笑出来。有一次，牌递过去之后，Spy 用拇指抚过 Scout 的手背。那让他很难安分地坐着，他又犯起抖腿的老毛病，直到 Spy 伸手过来按住他的大腿，把他拦了下来。而这一下还真就让他立马停住了。

The game lingered for long enough for the pair of them to accumulate a fantastic hand. Scout snuck his hand under the table again and squeezed Spy's wrist, their code that it was in the bag. Spy folded. Heavy didn't even have one pair, the dope.牌局拖得够久，久到他们俩都攒出了一手绝佳的好牌。Scout 又一次偷偷把手伸到桌下，捏了捏 Spy 的手腕——这是他们约定的暗号，意思是稳了。Spy 弃了牌。Heavy 连一对都没有，这个笨蛋。

"And what configuration of cards do you have, Scout?" Engineer asked. Scout smirked, cocky as shit. He dropped his cards face up. Under the table, he carefully tangled his fingers into Spy's.“那你手里的牌是什么配置，侦察兵？”工程师问道。侦察兵得意地一笑，嚣张得要命。他把牌正面朝上丢下。桌子底下，他小心翼翼地把手指与间谍的手指交缠在一起。

"All aces, baby," he said with a grin. "I got myself all fuckin' aces."“全是王牌，宝贝，”他咧嘴一笑，“我他妈给自己弄到了一手王牌。”
